scope.confusion_matrix_check: Every validation/evaluation confusion matrix in all 45 complete main result JSON files was independently converted to Accuracy and 21-class Macro-F1.
scope.prediction_check: All available NPZ artifacts under results/stage5/artifacts/*/main were independently evaluated using label and probabilities.argmax(axis=1); clean and unseen_combination artifacts only.
scope.paper_comparison: PDF Table II QC-HGT values were supplied by the parent agent after visual inspection; this subagent did not independently inspect the PDF.
scope.search_for_newer_results: Enumerated QC-HGT/result JSON and NPZ files in repository, searched results and docs for PDF value strings. No alternative aggregate supported the supplied PDF Table II values. No search outside repository.

recommendations.item: Use independent output directory and config/code/split hashes for each experiment. Current resume can silently skip new hyperparameters.
Evaluate train-fitted per-variable scaling and per-variable statistics scaling, retaining baseline/amplitude; LayerNorm of each raw 7-vector is not cross-sample standardization.

Increase maximum epochs to 100-150, use validation-only LR scheduling and patience 15-20; inspect classification/quality/consistency losses separately. Current QC runs all hit 30 epochs and best epochs are 27-30.

Increase independent train-run diversity before merely taking more overlapping windows. Start same-budget ablation with 5 windows/run (about 1000 runs) vs 20 windows/run (252 runs), then 25000-50000 windows shared by all baselines.

Report classwise metrics and onset-stratified evaluation; source fault_id-balanced sampling does not make final window labels balanced. Keep original 21-class all-window protocol rather than deleting difficult classes.
